mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% triggers a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing the 5% threshold, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in household demand (GDPC1) and decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals contractionary policy reversal, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline when both proxies move in expected directions, or the interaction's t-statistic < 1.96.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 signals an impending slowdown, reducing growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive when INDPRO falls below 98 during late-cycle periods, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in household demand (HOUST) above 10 units triggers immediate expansionary pressures, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise when HOUST crosses the 10-unit threshold, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When household demand (GDPC1) outpaces industrial production (INDPRO) growth, signaling excess demand, this creates upward pressure on equity prices, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not rise when GDPC1 up and INDPRO down, or the interaction's t-statistic < 1.96.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, reducing future cash flow valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite rising FEDFUNDS in a tightening cycle, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) during a contractionary phase amplifies economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not decline when both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rise, or the interaction's t-statistic < 1.96.
